description: Interactive: quizzes the reader. Call it when the user says "quiz me on Unity Catalog", "test me on Lakebase" or "check what I know about the Delta log". Five to eight multiple-choice questions on a chapter of the Field Guide, one section of it, or the whole guide, built deterministically from the guide's own tables, question-headed sections, FAQs and glossary: every question and every option is a phrase the guide states, and no model writes them. Each has its answer, the guide's explanation and the section URL. In a host that renders MCP Apps the reader answers and is scored in the view. In a terminal whose client shows forms (elicitation), each question is asked as a form and the score comes back with the explanations. Otherwise the text lists the questions and answers: ask the reader each one before revealing it, then call quiz_me again with the same chapter and section and their answers to score them. A reader who kept a resume code (Keep my progress, in a host without Fabric's view state) picks up with quiz_me and resume alone.

answers.description: The reader's answers, in question order, to score them: a letter (A to H) or an option's exact words, "" or "-" for none. Send the same chapter and section as the quiz that was asked.

chapter.description: A chapter's slug (unity-catalog, lakebase), path or URL; list_chapters has them. Omit for questions from across the guide.

domain.description: The exam's domain id, as exam_prep lists them

exam.description: Instead of a chapter: practice for a certification exam's domain (needs domain): data-engineer-associate, data-engineer-professional, data-analyst-associate, machine-learning-associate, machine-learning-professional, genai-engineer-associate, context-engineer-associate, apache-spark-developer-associate

resume.description: A resume code the reader kept from an earlier quiz (it starts kp1.): picks up where they left off. The code names its own chapter or exam domain, so nothing else is needed.

section.description: One section of that chapter: its anchor or heading. Needs chapter.

name: quiz_me

build.description: The commit of the deploy that answered

index_built.description: When this deploy's index was built (ISO 8601)

keep.description: For an interactive view: what its Keep my progress button makes a resume code from (scope), and the reader's place when a resume code was sent (resumed). Holds no personal data; nothing is stored on the server.

answer.description: The index of the right option

score.description: The reader's score, when they answered (answers, or the questions asked one at a time by elicitation); null otherwise

given.description: The letter the reader gave; null for none

stopped.description: The reader stopped before the last question

ttlMs.description: How long this answer may be kept before asking again, in milliseconds

title: Quiz me on the guide
